title: More Crafting Recipes
description: A mod that adds recipes to craft uncraftable items and to make other items easier to make.
body:
More Crafting Recipes is a NeoForge 1.21.4 mod that expands the crafting system by adding recipes for items that are normally uncraftable or unobtainable in vanilla Minecraft. From Elytra and chainmail armor to bedrock and reinforced deepslate, this mod gives players more freedom to obtain rare and valuable items through balanced, thoughtfully designed recipes. Whether you’re in survival mode and tired of relying on loot tables or just want more control over your progression, this mod makes it possible—without breaking the game’s core feel.

In addition to powerful and endgame-tier recipes, More Crafting Recipes includes smaller quality-of-life additions like the ability to smelt rotten flesh into edible charred meat that won’t give you the hunger effect. Every recipe is made with care to fit naturally into gameplay, offering both convenience and challenge. It’s a great fit for survival playthroughs, custom modpacks, or anyone who wants a little more logic and flexibility in their Minecraft experience.
